about: One installation = one company (docs/COMPANY_CONFIGURATION.md). Business defaults below are the starting values of Setup → Settings; a value changed there is kept in the local store and wins. The ERP block says which Oracle schema this installation reads and which write mapping belongs to it.

order_number.about: OC number (ORDMAS.DOCID) given on save when the reference is left empty: {fy} = financial year of the save day (26-27), {n} = next number of the series in ORDMAS. Remove this block to type every reference by hand.
